cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Truth or Loyalty
cards.instruction: Make someone choose between protecting the relationship and answering a dangerous question honestly.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The client asked if I copied the pitch. I taught you to handle difficult clients; now I need you to protect our partnership.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good, offer a solution before an explanation. You've remembered something. I'll withdraw it if you keep my name out.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She asked whether you copied it. Withdrawing doesn't answer her.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: No. So before you give her that beautifully direct answer, decide whether you still want to be my partner when the call ends.
